title: pocad-verdict-v1
description: One independent review of one build (kaynak: oguz-atolye atolye/schemas/verdict.schema.json @ca27b1b; PLAYBOOK section 6). Every gate row of the spec's section 5 appears in gates, PASS rows included. INCONCLUSIVE is never PASS. A finding blocks when it is a HARD-gate FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE, a missing spec feature, or a NO on the plausibility list; any blocking finding makes the verdict REVISE. No persona text anywhere. Written for claude --json-schema and codex exec --output-schema, so it keeps to the conservative subset of strict structured-output modes: every property required, no additional properties, null only through anyOf, no numeric or string constraints, no references.

review_id.description: RV01, RV02, ... in order per job; RETURNED for an incomplete submission, which is not a review.

target.description: The brief's target exactly, one token, e.g. lid_v02; build details go in the markdown, not here.

files.description: Every file the verdict covers; the delivery must carry exactly these bytes.

gates.description: One row per gate in the spec's section 5, measured independently from the exported STEP.

gate.description: The spec §5 row ID exactly, one per row; a row measured in several parts names the others in `at`. jobstate records each entry as a gate event whose gate is one token.

measured.description: null only when the status is INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_APPLICABLE; never 0 in place of a missing value.

unit.description: mm, deg, mm3, g, count, or bool (1 or 0); one token (mm/10deg, not mm per 10 deg).

required.description: The requirement as written in the spec, e.g. >= 1.20.

margin.description: Signed distance to the nearest limit, in unit; positive inside the limit.

at.description: Where the value was measured, e.g. (x, y, z) mm and the feature.

status.description: NOT_APPLICABLE only when the spec row names the parts it applies to and this target is not one of them; a row that cannot be measured is INCONCLUSIVE.

method.description: The tools/measure function or procedure used.

assumes.description: A-## ledger rows this result rests on; required for PASS_ASSUMED.

feature_census.description: Every feature in the design plan, counted in the exported STEP.

feature.description: Plan feature id and name, e.g. F02 bore x4.

plausibility.description: Every question of the GATES.md plausibility list, answered in one line.

question.description: Item id and short name, e.g. P1 gravity.

positive_controls.description: For each check family used, one mutant of this job's part that the check must FAIL.

got.description: Anything but FAIL leaves the gates that rely on this check INCONCLUSIVE.

findings.description: Each finding is a spec deviation with a functional-risk rating (D-022). Empty when there are none.

gate.description: Gate id, plan feature id, or plausibility item.

blocks.description: True for every kind except SOFT_GATE_MISS and OBSERVATION.

fix_direction.description: What would remove the deviation; the reviewer does not build it.

least_sure_answers.description: Each item from the REPORT's 'what I am least sure of', and what the review found.

assumptions_relied_on.description: Open A-## rows any PASS rests on; non-empty makes the verdict APPROVED_ASSUMPTION_CONDITIONAL at best.
